# Now 2.13.28
- Fixed the highlight jumping back to the previous line for an instant on every line change. The cause was in the playback clock, not the animation: the browser pushes a fresh position sample about once a second, and a sample landing slightly behind the running clock dragged it backward just enough to re-select the previous line at a line boundary. The active line now only moves forward, unless the clock moves back far enough to mean a real seek.

# Now 2.13.27
- Fixed the lyric scroll sliding past the incoming line and settling back. The scroll spring was slightly bouncy, which by definition travels past its target and returns — previously invisible because the old scroll view ignored that spring, but real once the column became spring-driven. The scroll is now critically damped: it glides to the line and stops. The active line keeps its subtle grow, which never moves the column.

# Now 2.13.26
- Fixed the lyric scroll jumping to the previous line and coming back on every line change. A line changed height when it became the active (karaoke) line, which shifted every line below it and made the scroll correct itself mid-glide. Line heights are now fixed for the whole song, so the column moves once, smoothly.
